name: gateway-admission-congestion-only R-3 live: a streaming response does not hold a provider admission slot
summary: Live sample of papercup-inference-gateway.service /admin/stats at 2026-10-14T04:50:57Z (process up 165 min). The test separates the two cases: each retained request records the provider admission 'running' count at the moment it was admitted. If a streaming response held its slot, every other request still mid-stream at that moment would be counted in 'running', so otherRequestsMidStream <= running - 1 always. Observed: for Codex, 167 of 196 admissions had more requests mid-stream than slots held (worst case 22 mid-stream vs 3 held). For Claude, 43 of 60 (worst case 9 mid-stream vs 1 held). Mid-stream counts only include retained requests, so they are lower bounds; the excess can only be larger. Account identities omitted.

assertions.id: R-3 codex: requests mid-stream exceed provider slots held at admission
assertions.evidence: Codex: 167 of 196 admissions saw otherRequestsMidStream > runningAtAdmit - 1. Max: request 24438 admitted 2026-10-14T04:48:27.321Z with runningAtAdmit 3 while 22 other Codex requests were mid-stream (excess 20). The alternative (a stream holds its slot) predicts excess <= 0 for every admission.

assertions.id: R-3 claude: requests mid-stream exceed provider slots held at admission
assertions.evidence: Claude: 43 of 60 admissions saw otherRequestsMidStream > runningAtAdmit - 1. Max: request 24483 admitted 2026-10-14T04:48:46.468Z with runningAtAdmit 1 while 9 other Claude requests were mid-stream (excess 9). Per D-004 the per-account governor slot still bounds Claude concurrency; this measures only the provider-lane admission slot.

distilled.method: For each retained request R in requestStages.recent with admission.provider.admitted: T = R.startedAt + admitted.offsetMs; held = admitted.running - 1 (running includes R itself). For each other streaming request S of the same provider: streamStart = S.startedAt + (S.durationsMs.total - S.durationsMs.stream), streamEnd = S.finalizedAt; S is mid-stream at T when streamStart < T < streamEnd. excess = midStream - held.
distilled.distiller: const j=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0,"utf8"));const rec=j.requestStages.recent.filter(r=>r.admission&&r.admission.provider&&r.admission.provider.admitted&&r.durationsMs);const out={};for(const prov of ["codex","claude"]){const P=rec.filter(r=>r.provider===prov);const iv=P.filter(r=>r.streaming).map(r=>({id:r.requestId,a:r.startedAt+(r.durationsMs.total-r.durationsMs.stream),b:r.finalizedAt}));let n=0,exceed=0,maxEx=null;for(const r of P){const run=r.admission.provider.admitted.running;if(run==null)continue;n++;const T=r.startedAt+r.admission.provider.admitted.offsetMs;const mid=iv.filter(s=>s.id!==r.requestId&&s.a<T&&T<s.b).length;const ex=mid-(run-1);if(ex>0)exceed++;if(!maxEx||ex>maxEx.excess)maxEx={requestId:r.requestId,admittedAt:new Date(T).toISOString(),runningAtAdmit:run,otherRequestsMidStream:mid,excess:ex};}out[prov]={retainedRequests:P.length,admissionsMeasured:n,admissionsWhereMidStreamExceedsHeldSlots:exceed,maxExcess:maxEx};}out.sampledAt=new Date().toISOString();out.processUptimeMs=j.processUptimeMs;console.log(JSON.stringify(out));
